data.research_question: Can the duplicate WEF-facing and legal-issuer Palantir organization records be resolved without losing provenance, and what does that imply for current headquarters/location evidence?
data.method: Applied seeded dataset-first selection; rejected a blocked OCCRP Aleph target; compared current WEF organization, WEF executive, WEF partner, SEC issuer, and existing first-party location evidence; searched current Palantir news and first-party surfaces through 2026-08-19.
classification_rules: Legal issuer identity and display-name identity may be equivalent while retaining source-specific labels.
Principal executive office and headquarters are not silently treated as identical semantics.
Newer first-party/regulatory location evidence outranks stale third-party profile text for current organizational location.
No news record is created when the current search adds no material event or correction.

findings.finding: WEF's Alex Karp profile explicitly uses Palantir Technologies Inc., providing a primary-source bridge between WEF's Palantir Technologies display name and the SEC legal issuer.
WEF's Palantir organization profile still says Denver headquarters, while newer Palantir/SEC evidence places the principal executive office in Aventura, Florida.
Current-news searches through 2026-08-19 found no material new event changing the identity or location conclusion; no filler event was ingested.
